title: My shop
subtitle: The products you list. Nobody else's, and nobody else sees yours here.
renameHint: Changing this changes the name under every one of your listings at once.
describeHint: A few words shoppers read on your shop's page. Leave it empty to show none.

empty.title: You have not listed anything yet.
empty.body: A product you list here appears in the catalogue straight away, with your shop name under it.

listing.loadFailed: Your listings could not be loaded.

create.title: List a product
create.name: Name
create.skuHint: Your own code for it. It has to be unique across the whole shop.

consequences.title: Three things this does, so nothing surprises you later
consequences.language: The text you type is stored in {{language}}. Shoppers reading the other language see this text until you translate it.
consequences.currency: The price is in {{currency}} only. Shoppers paying in the other currency will see the product but cannot buy it until it has a price there.
consequences.stock: A new listing has no stock until you set it, on the listing's own page.

create.detailsHint: What shoppers see. Variants, translations, a second currency and photographs come next, on the listing's page.

edit.title: Your listing
edit.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw “{{name}}”? It leaves the catalogue and cannot be undone.
edit.view: See it as a shopper does
edit.imageHint: Shown on the product card and wherever a variant has no photograph of its own.
edit.variantsHint: Each variant is priced and stocked on its own. Leave a currency empty to not sell in it.

stock.title: Stock
stock.notRegisteredYet: This listing is still being registered with the warehouse. Try again in a moment.
stock.hint: How many you have. Orders reserve from this, so it cannot be set below what is already held.
stock.lowStockHint: You are told when a sale takes this below the number. Leave it empty for the shop default; 0 never warns.

variantImage.title: Photograph of this shape
variantImage.hint: Optional. Without one, this shape shows the product's photograph.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Orders that include something you listed. You see your own lines only - not the rest of the order - and the customer's address only while your part is waiting or being prepared.
sales.none: Nothing you listed has been bought yet. An order appears here once it has been paid.
sales.loadFailed: Your sales could not be loaded.
sales.subtotalHint: Before tax, your goods only. The commission and your share of delivery are under “You receive”.

overview.subtitle: How your shop is doing, and what needs you.
overview.revenueHint: Your lines only, before tax. Each currency on its own.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.payoutAccount: Add the account your payouts go to - the shop cannot pay you without one

products.search: Search your listings by name or SKU

fulfil.title: Your parcel
fulfil.hint: You ship your own part of this order. The customer sees each parcel and its tracking reference.
fulfil.progress: Where your parcel has got to
fulfil.shipHint: Enter the carrier's tracking reference. The customer follows it; a mistake can be corrected until the parcel is delivered.
fulfil.addressGone: Your parcel has been sent, so the delivery address is no longer shown.
fulfil.cancelled: This order was cancelled - there is nothing to prepare or send.
fulfil.partCancelled: You cancelled your part of this order: {{reason}}. The buyer was refunded for it.

earnings.title: You receive
earnings.unrecorded: This order was placed before the shop recorded commission and delivery shares, so there is no amount to pay out for it.

hint.onTheWay: The customer has paid. It becomes due once they receive the parcel - or 7 days after it shipped if they never confirm.
hint.due: The customer received the parcel. The shop settles it in its next payout.
hint.paidOut: The shop has recorded paying you for this.

earnings.cancelled: The order was cancelled, so nothing is owed to you for it.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: What the shop owes you: your goods less commission, plus your share of delivery. Each currency on its own.
payouts.nothingYet: Nothing yet. Money shows here once an order with your goods is paid.
payouts.none: The shop has not paid you out yet.

apply.title: Open a shop
apply.subtitle: Sell your own cameras and lenses here. A moderator looks at every new shop before it opens.
apply.descriptionHint: A sentence or two helps the review go quickly.
apply.sent: Application sent. You will be told here and in your notifications.
apply.pendingBody: Somebody will look at it soon. You cannot send another while this one waits.
apply.confirmFirst: Confirm your email address before applying to sell - we sent a link to {{email}}. You can ask for a new one at the top of the page.

review.pendingBody: Shoppers cannot see or buy it until a moderator approves it. You will be told.
review.rejectedBody: Reason: {{reason}}. Change what was asked, then send it back.
review.approvedHint: On sale. Changing its name, description or photographs sends it back for review; prices and stock do not.

return.title: Return
return.hint: The buyer wants to send this parcel back. Answer within a few days - a refusal can be taken to the shop’s staff.

state.Requested: Asked on {{at}}. Accept or refuse it.
state.Accepted: Accepted. Waiting for the buyer to send it back.
state.Refused: Refused: {{reason}}. The buyer can ask the shop’s staff to look again.
state.Escalated: The buyer took the refusal to the shop’s staff, who decide for good.
state.SentBack: Sent back on {{at}} ({{reference}}). Mark it received when it arrives.
state.Received: Received back on {{at}}. The buyer was refunded

return.acceptBody: The buyer is told to send the parcel back. When it arrives and is marked received, they are refunded the goods and their tax, and the units go back in stock.
return.refuseBody: The buyer reads your reason and can ask the shop’s staff to look again.
return.rejectBody: This is the final word: the buyer cannot take it any further. They read your reason.
return.receiveBody: The buyer is refunded the goods and their tax, and the units go back in stock. It cannot be undone.
return.receivedDone: Received - the buyer is being refunded.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: How your shop is doing: what you sold, what sells, what people look at. Money is shown per currency and counts your own goods before tax - not delivery, and not a parcel returned and refunded.

questions.title: Questions
questions.subtitle: What shoppers asked about your products. Your answer is public on the product page, as your shop.

payoutAccount.title: Payout account
payoutAccount.hint: Where the shop sends what it owes you.
payoutAccount.none: No payout account yet - the shop cannot pay you until you add one.
payoutAccount.emailed: We email you whenever this changes. If you get that email and did not change it, change your password.

shopState.title: Your shop
shopState.pauseBody: Your products leave the shop until you reopen it - nobody can find or buy them. Orders already paid still wait for you to ship them.
shopState.pausedSince: Paused since {{at}}. Shoppers see that you are away.
shopState.closedBecause: Staff closed your shop on {{at}}: {{reason}}. Your products are off the shop until staff reopen it; orders already paid still need shipping.
shopState.suspended: Your account is banned, so your shop is closed.
shopState.failed: The shop could not be changed.

returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: Parcels of yours that buyers want to send back, oldest waiting first.
returns.loadFailed: Your returns could not be loaded.

details.title: Name, description and category
details.hint: The original text: what every reader sees unless their language has its own, below.

text.title: Text in each language
text.hint: A language with its own text shows it; one without shows the original above.
text.none: None yet - {{language}} readers see the original.
text.removed: {{language}} text removed - its readers see the original.

addVariant.title: Add a variant
addVariant.hint: Another kit, colour or size. It starts with no stock; set its stock and other prices once it is added.
addVariant.firstOption: Sold one way so far: give the new shape an option that tells it apart, such as Colour: Silver.
